run_manual_env_shell: run the CompilerGym interactive shell with python -m compiler_gym.bin.manual_env --env=<env>
run_hill_climb_search: run hill climbing search in the CompilerGym shell to accept only positive reward actions
run_greedy_search: run greedy search in the CompilerGym shell to select the highest reward action each step
run_apply_compiler_action: run a compiler action like tailcallelim or loop-unroll on the current benchmark in the shell
run_simplify_action_stack: run simplify_stack in the CompilerGym shell to remove no-effect or negative reward actions
